deleted_2026_08_02.why: Phase 1's actual bar (Bean): 'I want the vast majority of all migrations deleted and replaced'. These are deleted because their effects are now reproducible WITHOUT them: schema.sql carries every CREATE/ALTER, and the committed seed files (property-suffixes.json 154, slots.json 104, excluded-properties.json 10, roles.json 29, modifier-suffixes.json 19, atomic-tag-map.json 17, scalar-media-roles.json) were CAPTURED FROM LIVE — i.e. from the post-migration state — so every data effect is already baked into a committed artefact. bootstrap_rebuild() never replayed them anyway (replay is a proven dead end: slot_synonyms was retired, so May migrations cannot run against an August schema). Full history remains in git.
